Most task issues are created from the plan by `scripts/github_sync.py`. Use this
template only for a task the plan doesn't hold yet, and add its card to
`docs/04-build-plan.md` in the same week. The card in the plan is the source of truth.

`S` or `M` · Jack-led or Claude-led · after … · branch `type/id-short-name`

**Learn:** what you will understand afterwards (the drill, for Jack-led tasks).

**Build:** what to make, in a few lines.

**Done when:**
- [ ] a check anyone can verify

**Tests:** `test_names_to_write_first`

**Commits:** `test(scope): …` → `feat(scope): …`
